scope: DOCX body text, table rows, cells and their paragraphs in source order
normalization: NFKC; Unicode casefold; retain alphanumeric characters only
limitations: Unicode NFKC, case folding and removal of non-alphanumeric characters make line wrapping, spacing and punctuation differences insignificant. This check therefore does not certify punctuation, signs, units or typography.

Ordered matching preserves the multiplicity of source paragraphs and table rows. Each cell and its paragraphs are checked inside its matched row; a copy of the same text elsewhere cannot validate a missing row.
Extra PDF text, including repeated table headings, is allowed. This is a source-content inclusion check, not a byte-for-byte or semantic comparison.

DOCX running headers, footers and page fields are excluded from body-text matching. Images, drawing content and hyperlink destinations require other checks. Nested tables or unenumerated body paragraphs fail closed.
A successful text check does not prove that text is visible, unclipped or legible. A separate visual review of every final page remains required.
